subject: [PATCH v3 12/12] mm/collapse: implement MADV_COLLAPSE in madvise.c

2026-09-16.patch_summary: This patch moves the implementation of MADV_COLLAPSE from khugepaged.c to madvise.c, where it belongs among other madvise operations. This change simplifies the code and removes unnecessary dependencies between the daemon's file and the syscall code. The MADV_COLLAPSE operation is a caller of the interface used by khugepaged, so its functionality remains unchanged. Additionally, the !CONFIG_TRANSPARENT_HUGEPAGE stub is moved along with the implementation.
